weighted_skill_margin.description: Category-weighted competency surplus across communication, product knowledge, sales, and customer service relative to task minimums.

min_skill_margin.description: Smallest individual competency margin across communication, product knowledge, sales, customer service, and overall assessment score.

weakest_link_deficit.description: Non-positive bottleneck deficit (min(0.0, min_skill_margin)), capturing risk when the weakest sub-skill falls below the task target.

exp_surplus_tanh.description: Saturating relevant experience surplus above task minimum: tanh((task_relevant_exp - task_min_exp) / 12.0).

difficulty_tier.description: Numeric task difficulty tier (1 = Low / Foundational, 2 = Medium / Standard, 3 = High / Advanced).

cert_satisfied.description: Mandatory certification satisfaction indicator (1 = satisfied, 0 = unsatisfied; always 1 for Stage 1 eligible pairs, retained for schema completeness).
